translations.web: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
translations.bsb: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you, if you find my beloved, tell him I am sick with love.
translations.kjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.
